notes.title: Patch notes for v0.2.9
notes.content: [p]The following items have been either fixed or added: [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added a compass to the player's HUD to assist with orientation.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a 'death' marker to the compass to guide players back to their loot crate after dying.[/p][/*][*][p]Added world landmarks to improve player orientation.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a 'safe zone' to the bunker. As long as all players are inside, zombie waves will no longer spawn. Existing zombies will still attempt to attack players in the bunker.[/p][/*][*][p]Added loot drops to zombies.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a legend to certain UI screens.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new objectives to guide players in unlocking specific rooms within the bunker.[/p][/*][*][p]Added help text indicating where crafted weapons are placed after using the workbench.[/p][/*][*][p]Added main menu text promoting team play.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the hunger gauge depletion rate from 1 to 0.5. [/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the thirst gauge depletion rate from 1 to 0.5. [/p][/*][*][p]Increased the zombie horde spawn interval from 120–240 seconds to 300–420 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the 'Craft a Weapon' objective.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the 'Unknown Transmission' objective would not always appear in the objective list.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where open-world containers would sometimes have no items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where dead zombie bodies would appear stretched.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some objectives would not correctly show as 'Failed' in the objectives list.[/p][/*][*][p]Potentially fixed an issue where zombies would sometimes stand still and stop attacking after a player dies or becomes untargetable. [/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Added a compass to the player's HUD to assist with orientation.
Added a 'death' marker to the compass to guide players back to their loot crate after dying.
Added world landmarks to improve player orientation.
Added a 'safe zone' to the bunker. As long as all players are inside, zombie waves will no longer spawn. Existing zombies will still attempt to attack players in the bunker.
Added a legend to certain UI screens.
Added new objectives to guide players in unlocking specific rooms within the bunker.
Added help text indicating where crafted weapons are placed after using the workbench.
Added main menu text promoting team play.

tags.balance_change: Reduced the hunger gauge depletion rate from 1 to 0.5.
Reduced the thirst gauge depletion rate from 1 to 0.5.
Increased the zombie horde spawn interval from 120–240 seconds to 300–420 seconds.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where the 'Unknown Transmission' objective would not always appear in the objective list.
Fixed an issue where open-world containers would sometimes have no items.
Fixed an issue where dead zombie bodies would appear stretched.
Fixed an issue where some objectives would not correctly show as 'Failed' in the objectives list.
Potentially fixed an issue where zombies would sometimes stand still and stop attacking after a player dies or becomes untargetable.

notes.title: Patch notes for v0.2.8
notes.content: [p]The following items have been either fixed or added: [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added an "exit" sign to indicate the exit of the bunker.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the width of the Main Menu sidebar to be more consistent with various resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where crafting and salvaging weapons would use/return insufficient materials.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where it would be possible to have a negative amount of weight, permanently bugging the weight mechanic.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where target dummies in the Armory would not register shots properly. [/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Added an "exit" sign to indicate the exit of the bunker.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted the width of the Main Menu sidebar to be more consistent with various resolutions.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where crafting and salvaging weapons would use/return insufficient materials.
Fixed an issue where it would be possible to have a negative amount of weight, permanently bugging the weight mechanic.
Fixed an issue where target dummies in the Armory would not register shots properly.

notes.title: Patch notes for v0.2.7
notes.content: [p]The following items have been either fixed or added: [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added a weight indicator in the inventory and container UI's.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a auto-save mechanic that occurs every 3 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a manual save button for the server.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where roaming zombies would not correctly agro the players.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Ambient music. It now plays correctly in the morning and evening.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player would be uncontrollable near the beach. tags.feature: Added a weight indicator in the inventory and container UI's.
Added a auto-save mechanic that occurs every 3 minutes.
Added a manual save button for the server.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where roaming zombies would not correctly agro the players.
Fixed the Ambient music. It now plays correctly in the morning and evening.
Fixed an issue where the player would be uncontrollable near the beach.

tags.balance_change: Re-ordered the stat-icons below the healthbar to be more intuitive.
